product: Crimson Wildflower Maxi Skirt (pilot, elastic waistband)
README: The waistband of the pilot skirt is NOT measured yet. Every number under `assumed` is an assumption, not a measurement. When the founder has the tape numbers, fill `measured` (relaxed and stretched band girth of the sample, flat hem sweep) and run drape.sh with BAND=measured: nothing else changes. `relaxedGirthCm` is the band's full girth lying relaxed (flat width x 2); `stretchedGirthCm` the full girth pulled to its comfortable maximum; `hemSweepCm` the full hem girth (flat hem width x 2). If only the sample size is measured, `gradePerSizeCm` says how much the band changes per chart size (null = assume the chart's waist step, 5 cm per AU size).

assumed.note: ASSUMED, not measured. relaxed(size) = chart waist(size) + offsetCm when graded, else the fixed girth for every size; stretched = relaxed x stretchRatio. The elastic stiffness relative to the fabric is assumed too (elasticToFabricStiffness).

W-0.why: band relaxed = body waist of the size: loose at the low-rise line

W-6.why: typical elastic skirt band, about 6 cm under the body waist (assumption, not a measurement)

ONE-70.why: one band for every size (the 'every size hangs from the same band' hypothesis of REFINEMENT R3)
